_comment: LOD ranges and cross-fades (docs/LOD.md, src/render/lod_fade.c). Applies to the classic renderer (r_vgeo 0) and the systems it shares (characters, terrain, VFX spawn LOD); r_vgeo 1 and r_lod_legacy 1 keep the ranges from before. Every range = the value below x r_lod_bias (locked 1); the same at every Engine Fidelity level and era (docs/SETTINGS_AUDIT.md). Reload: r_lod_reload.

fade._comment: time: s, time-based cross-fades (characters, their shadows; r_lod_fade_time). band: octaves of projected size over which stateless instances cross-fade (classic LOD chains; r_lod_fade_band).

distance._comment: x the distance of every switch before docs/LOD.md. characters: 1 (the px table below holds the new targets).

tiers._comment: per Engine Fidelity level: must be 1 (docs/SETTINGS_AUDIT.md: the ranges decide what a player can see, so every level has the same; a level over budget renders cheaper, not shorter).

eras._comment: per-era multipliers: must be 1, like the tiers (docs/SETTINGS_AUDIT.md).

characters._comment: projected height (px at 1080p-equivalent render height, bias 1): LOD0 above px[0], LOD1 above px[1], LOD2 above px[2], LOD3 below (was 260 / 120 / 50). update_every: pose ticks per LOD; update_ramp_s: s per octave of interval change. ik_band: foot IK / lean fade over this fraction below the LOD0 threshold.

impostor._comment: band: octaves of projected size over which mesh and impostor cross-fade (the impostor fades in past the switch size). gain: impostor albedo x this so its mean colour matches the mesh (baked normals catch less sky than the mesh's bent leaf normals; measured: -8 % luminance at 1, -4 % at 1.2, docs/LOD.md).

foliage._comment: band: x the length of a material's fade band (start .. end); instance_fade: width of one instance's fade (fraction of the band, was 1/16); shrink: scale of an instance at the end of its fade.

terrain._comment: detail_range: x the surface detail distances (anti-tiling 70-110 m, triplanar 160 m); morph: octaves of the geomorph band at the far end of each chunk LOD.

shadow._comment: band: fraction of a caster's shadow distance over which its shadow fades out (was a cut).

streaming._comment: prefetch: classic LODs are made resident when an instance is within this many octaves of switching to them.
